message.content:
This editorial illustration for Tempo magazine features a stylized caricature of a person with blue hair and glasses, wearing a red-and-black plaid shirt and blue pants. This central figure is positioned in the middle of the frame, holding a large axe with both hands, poised as if to strike downward. The axe has a light-colored wooden handle and a blue-toned metal head.

The background consists of textured, rounded green shapes reminiscent of a forest canopy or rolling hills. The magazine's title, "TEMPO," is at the top in large, red, serif letters, partially obscured by the axe. Smaller white text is scattered around: "AKAR PERANG PREMAN MALUKU" and "KEMBANG-KEMPIS BISNIS PLN" at the top; a block of text on the right about "KEBIJAKAN MENTERI LINGKUNGAN HIDUP DAN KEHUTANAN SITI NURBAYA"; and "INVESTIGASI PETAKA HUTAN HARAPAN" in large white and red block letters. A barcode, issue date ("3-9 AGUSTUS 2020"), and price are at the bottom left, while a QR code is at the bottom right. A solid red vertical border lines the left edge.
